spans.text: “Ariṭṭho nāma, bhikkhave, paccekasambuddho imasmiṁ isigilismiṁ pabbate ciranivāsī ahosi; “The independent Buddhas who dwelt for a long time on this Isigili were named Ariṭṭha, nīto nāma, bhikkhave, paccekasambuddho imasmiṁ isigilismiṁ pabbate ciranivāsī ahosi; Nīta, tatho nāma, bhikkhave, paccekasambuddho imasmiṁ isigilismiṁ pabbate ciranivāsī ahosi, Tatha, sutavā nāma, bhikkhave, paccekasambuddho imasmiṁ isigilismiṁ pabbate ciranivāsī ahosi; Sutavā, bhāvitatto nāma, bhikkhave, paccekasambuddho imasmiṁ isigilismiṁ pabbate ciranivāsī ahosi.

Ketumbharāgo ca mātaṅgo ariyo, Ketumbharāga, Mātaṅga, and Ariya, Athaccuto accutagāmabyāmako; then Accuta, Accutagāma, and Byāmaka, Sumaṅgalo dabbilo supatiṭṭhito, Sumaṅgala, Dabbila, Supatiṭṭhita, Athassumegho anīgho sudāṭho; then Assumegha, Anīgha, and Sudāṭha, Asayho khemābhirato ca sorato.
Listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

Buddho ahu maṅgalo vītarāgo, Maṅgala was awakened, free of greed, Paccekabuddhā bhavanettikhīṇā, Independent Buddhas, enders of the leash to existence; Usabhacchidā jāliniṁ dukkhamūlaṁ; Usabha cut the net, the root of suffering, Santaṁ padaṁ ajjhagamopanīto, Upanīta who attained the state of peace, Uposatho sundaro saccanāmo.
